Disciple's Death at Premanand Maharaj Ashram: New CCTV Footage Emerges

Eleven days after the death of Rasik Dulari Sharan, a disciple of Premanand Maharaj, at his Vrindavan ashram, a fourth CCTV video has surfaced. The new footage, released on Tuesday, reportedly shows the disciple's unsteady steps and movement towards stairs and a gallery prior to her death. The circumstances surrounding her death remain a mystery.
